summary: HFT L2 independent consumer implemented in draft Icarus PR #488, head cd74368505cf973f6d22431bd3cac884a090098c. It reconstructs every normalized depth/trade event from original CSV, checks independent caller-supplied source SHA-256, manifest/source/output SHA-256, exact event flags/fields, contract, tick/lot grid, exchange/local clocks, sequence, counts, first/last timestamps and all denied authority. It rejects source/output tampering even if manifest is rehashed, duplicate JSON keys, symlinked inputs and forged MBO IDs. Focused exact-head run 40569161758 passed 23 tests each Python 3.10/3.11/3.12/3.13, including actual stage-to-consumer roundtrip. Coordination draft PR #74 stacked on repaired #71; coordination CI 40569271043 passed with 426 events, 52 sessions, 0 collisions. Broad exact-head Icarus CI runs 40569149528 and 40569162153 still in progress. No licensed market-data replay, native HFTBacktest/NumPy, empirical fills, source entitlements, WSL2 runtime or live trading claims.
